nodes.label: config paths section
nodes.summary: data_dir, processed_dir, output_dir, log_dir — the strict filesystem layout.

nodes.label: config model section
nodes.summary: image_size [256,256] and num_classes 10 — the model shape parameters.

nodes.label: config training section
nodes.summary: learning_rate 1e-4, num_epochs 100, k_folds 5, random_seed 42, deterministic true, test_subjects [].

nodes.label: config loss section
nodes.summary: ce_weight 0.5, dice_weight 0.5, class_weights null — the CombinedLoss parameters.

nodes.label: config optimizer section
nodes.summary: Global default optimizer: adam, weight_decay 0.0, betas [0.9,0.999], grad_clip_norm 1.0.

nodes.label: config scheduler section
nodes.summary: Global default scheduler: reduce_on_plateau, patience 5, factor 0.5, warmup_frac 0.05.

nodes.label: config recipes section
nodes.summary: model_families maps each registered key to cnn or transformer; families defines each family's optimizer/scheduler override, null inheriting the global recipe.

nodes.label: config preprocessing section
nodes.summary: normalization fixed_range with fixed_range_celsius [20.0, 40.0]; a runtime-pure switch because normalization is applied at load.

nodes.label: config regions list
nodes.summary: Ordered 10 Portuguese class names, index 0 background; the source from which lateral index pairs are derived.

nodes.label: training.test_subjects
nodes.summary: Subjects held out from all CV folds and scored separately; default empty means CV only. Overridable via TEST_SUBJECTS.

nodes.label: training.deterministic
nodes.summary: When true (default), seed_everything is the single owner of cuDNN flags; when false cudnn.benchmark=True is allowed for speed.

nodes.label: training.k_folds
nodes.summary: Requested CV fold count (5), reduced to the subject count when fewer subjects exist.

nodes.label: training.num_epochs
nodes.summary: Epoch budget (100), overridable by --epochs via the NUM_EPOCHS env var.

nodes.label: training.random_seed
nodes.summary: Global seed 42, also used for the seeded DataLoader generator and A.Compose.

nodes.label: loss.class_weights
nodes.summary: null for uniform (default), 'balanced' for inverse train-fold frequency recomputed per fold from the training split only, or an explicit per-class list.

nodes.label: preprocessing.normalization
nodes.summary: fixed_range (default, preserves absolute temperature) or per_image_minmax (legacy, destroys it).

nodes.label: preprocessing.fixed_range_celsius
nodes.summary: [20.0, 40.0] °C mapped linearly to [0,1] at load time.

nodes.label: recipes.model_families
nodes.summary: unet->cnn; transunet, swin_unet_plus_plus, swin_pretrained and transunet_pretrained -> transformer.

nodes.label: codes/config.yaml
nodes.summary: THE single validated configuration authority: paths, model shape, training/CV/reproducibility, loss, global optimizer and scheduler, per-family recipes, thermal preprocessing and the ordered 10 region names.
